# Costco
> Costco’s online shopping and member services platform for warehouse deals, grocery delivery, travel, pharmacy, optical, and customer support.

Costco.com combines e-commerce, membership benefits, and service offerings across retail, grocery, travel, health, business purchasing, and account management. It also links to specialized Costco services such as same-day delivery, photo products, and member support resources.

## Shopping & Deals
- [Costco Home](https://www.costco.com/): Main shopping portal for Costco products, categories, promotions, and member-exclusive online offers.
- [Warehouse Savings](https://www.costco.com/warehouse-savings.html): Current coupon book and promotional savings available to Costco members.
- [Grocery](https://www.costco.com/grocery-household.html): Online grocery, pantry, beverages, and household essentials shopping.
- [Electronics](https://www.costco.com/electronics.html): TVs, computers, audio, cameras, and consumer electronics products.
- [Appliances](https://www.costco.com/appliances.html): Major kitchen and home appliances with delivery and installation options.
- [Furniture](https://www.costco.com/furniture.html): Indoor and outdoor furniture for living, dining, bedroom, and office spaces.
- [New & Featured](https://www.costco.com/new-featured.html): Recently added products, seasonal items, and featured merchandise.
- [Coupons](https://www.costco.com/coupons.html): Online coupons and limited-time discounts across major product categories.

## Grocery & Delivery
- [Same-Day](https://sameday.costco.com/): Instacart-powered same-day grocery and household delivery from Costco.
- [Same-Day Storefront](https://sameday.costco.com/store/costco/storefront): Browse Costco same-day delivery inventory, pricing, and local availability.
- [2-Day Grocery](https://www.costco.com/grocery-household.html?dept=All): Shelf-stable grocery and household items available for parcel delivery.
- [Cold & Frozen](https://www.costco.com/cold-frozen.html): Refrigerated and frozen foods available for online ordering.
- [Snacks](https://www.costco.com/snacks.html): Snack foods, bars, nuts, chips, and packaged treats.
- [Beverages](https://www.costco.com/beverages.html): Water, soda, coffee, tea, juice, and other drink selections.

## Membership & Account
- [Membership](https://www.costco.com/membership.html): Membership plans, benefits, pricing, and sign-up information.
- [Join Costco](https://www.costco.com/join-costco.html): Online membership enrollment for new Costco members.
- [Executive Membership](https://www.costco.com/executive-rewards.html): Details on Executive membership rewards and added benefits.
- [Renew Membership](https://www.costco.com/renew-membership.html): Online membership renewal for existing members.
- [Register Account](https://www.costco.com/LogonForm): Create or activate a Costco.com online account.
- [Sign In](https://www.costco.com/LogonForm): Member login for shopping, orders, and account access.
- [Order Status](https://www.costco.com/OrderStatusCmd): Check online order status and recent purchase information.
- [My Account](https://www.costco.com/my-account.html): Central account area for profile, orders, and membership settings.

## Customer Service & Policies
- [Customer Service](https://customerservice.costco.com/): Help center for orders, returns, membership, and account support.
- [Returns & Exchanges](https://customerservice.costco.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/1191): Overview of Costco return and exchange policies.
- [Shipping](https://customerservice.costco.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/1001204): Shipping methods, delivery timing, and order fulfillment information.
- [Order Cancellation](https://customerservice.costco.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/8150): Instructions for canceling eligible Costco.com orders.
- [Price Adjustment](https://customerservice.costco.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/628): Policy details for requesting a price adjustment.
- [Product Recalls](https://customerservice.costco.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/1193): Safety recall notices and affected Costco products.
- [Contact Us](https://customerservice.costco.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/829): Contact options for Costco customer support.
- [Site Map](https://www.costco.com/site-map.html): Directory of Costco.com categories, services, and informational pages.

## Pharmacy, Optical & Health
- [Pharmacy](https://www.costco.com/pharmacy/home-delivery): Costco pharmacy services and prescription management entry point.
- [Pharmacy Home Delivery](https://www.costco.com/pharmacy/home-delivery): Mail-order prescription fulfillment and pharmacy account access.
- [Optical](https://www.costco.com/optical.html): Eyeglasses, contact lenses, and Costco Optical service information.
- [Hearing Aids](https://www.costco.com/hearing-aid-center.html): Hearing aid products, services, and hearing center resources.
- [Health & Beauty](https://www.costco.com/health-beauty.html): Personal care, wellness, vitamins, and beauty products.
- [Vision Center](https://www.costco.com/optical.html): Optical shopping and member vision service information.

## Travel & Auto Services
- [Costco Travel](https://www.costcotravel.com/): Member travel booking for vacations, cruises, rental cars, and hotels.
- [Vacation Packages](https://www.costcotravel.com/Vacation-Packages): Curated vacation packages for popular destinations and resorts.
- [Rental Cars](https://www.costcotravel.com/Rental-Cars): Discounted rental car booking for Costco members.
- [Cruises](https://www.costcotravel.com/Cruises): Cruise search and booking across major cruise lines.
- [Hotels](https://www.costcotravel.com/Hotels): Hotel booking options available through Costco Travel.
- [Auto Program](https://www.costcoauto.com/): Vehicle buying program with participating dealers and member pricing.
- [Auto Buying Research](https://www.costcoauto.com/research/): Vehicle research tools, reviews, and model comparisons.

## Business & Financial Services
- [Costco Business Center](https://www.costcobusinessdelivery.com/): Business-focused ordering for office, foodservice, and janitorial supplies.
- [Business Delivery](https://www.costcobusinessdelivery.com/): Delivery service for business inventory and workplace essentials.
- [Business Membership](https://www.costco.com/business-delivery.html): Information on Costco business shopping and delivery options.
- [Costco Next](https://www.costconext.com/): Member access to curated brands offering special direct-purchase pricing.
- [Costco Services](https://www.costco.com/services.html): Member services marketplace for home, business, and financial needs.
- [Check Printing](https://www.costcochecks.com/): Costco-branded check ordering and related financial stationery.
- [Credit Card](https://www.costco.com/credit-card.html): Information about Costco co-branded credit card benefits and application details.

## Photo & Personalized Products
- [Photo Center](https://www.costcophotocenter.com/): Photo products, prints, cards, and personalized gift ordering.
- [Photo Gifts](https://www.costcophotocenter.com/home/photo-gifts): Personalized photo gifts and custom keepsake products.
- [Wall Art](https://www.costcophotocenter.com/home/wall-decor): Custom wall décor including canvas, metal, and framed prints.
- [Cards & Stationery](https://www.costcophotocenter.com/home/cards-stationery): Personalized cards, announcements, and stationery products.
- [Calendars](https://www.costcophotocenter.com/home/calendars): Custom photo calendars for personal and gift use.
- [Prints](https://www.costcophotocenter.com/home/prints): Standard photo print ordering and enlargement options.

## Seasonal & Specialty
- [Patio, Lawn & Garden](https://www.costco.com/patio-lawn-garden.html): Outdoor furniture, grills, gardening, and seasonal exterior products.
- [Mattresses](https://www.costco.com/mattresses.html): Mattress shopping across memory foam, hybrid, and adjustable options.
- [Jewelry](https://www.costco.com/jewelry.html): Fine jewelry including rings, earrings, necklaces, and watches.
- [Gift Cards & Tickets](https://www.costco.com/gift-cards-tickets.html): Discounted gift cards, event tickets, and entertainment offers.
- [Tires](https://tires.costco.com/): Tire shopping, installation appointments, and tire center services.
- [Wine, Beer & Spirits](https://www.costco.com/wine-beer-spirits.html): Alcohol category browsing where legally available.
- [Baby, Kids & Toys](https://www.costco.com/baby-kids-toys.html): Baby gear, children’s products, and toy selections.
